name: campus-live
description: Campus Live: a live campus map of crowds, parking and traffic from camera counts

scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @campus-live/contracts && npm run build -w @campus-live/client
scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && concurrently -n api,vision,web -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev -w @campus-live/api" "npm run dev:vision" "npm run dev -w @campus-live/web"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:packages && npm run dev -w @campus-live/api
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:packages && npm run dev -w @campus-live/web
scripts.dev:mobile: npm run build:packages && npm run start -w @campus-live/mobile
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm test --workspaces --if-present && node --test "scripts/**/*.test.mjs"
